description.value: Centuries ago, Rahm saved the Avekiri of Enara from certain death, and allowed them to repel the Drachiri. Great avian spirits have favored and watched the avekiri no matter where they have gone. Whether through their blessings or through a reverence for them, you’ve gained the power to transform into a powerful avian creature yourself. You gain the Aerial Form innate spell that you can cast as an 8th rank divine spell once per day. You must transform into an avian or similar birdlike creature, and you use your normal AC if it is higher than what is granted by the battle form. You triple the damage die instead of doubling it from the 6th rank Aerial Form benefits, and grant a +2 status bonus to your attack and damage rolls with the form’s unarmed attacks and Acrobatics checks made in this form.
